segments.name: Real Estate
segments.description: Global real estate investing across opportunistic, stabilized and debt strategies for institutional and individual investors.
segments.evidence: Our Real Estate business is a global leader in real estate investing, with $319.3 billion of Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Private Equity
segments.description: Global private equity, infrastructure, secondaries and capital markets businesses for institutional and individual investors.
segments.evidence: Our Private Equity segment encompasses global businesses with a total of approximately 720 employees managing $416.4 billion of Total Assets Under Management as of December 31, 2025.

segments.name: Credit & Insurance
segments.description: Corporate and asset based credit management, including CLOs and insurance investment management, for clients and borrowers.
segments.evidence: BXCI offers its clients and borrowers a comprehensive solution across corporate and asset based credit, including investment grade and non-investment grade debt.

segments.name: Multi-Asset Investing
segments.description: Discretionary allocation to hedge funds and multi-asset portfolio construction across public and private markets.
segments.evidence: BXMA, the world's largest discretionary allocator to hedge funds, is a leader in building multi-asset portfolios.

revenueModel.text: Blackstone earns management fees and performance revenues from investors in its funds and vehicles.
revenueModel.evidence: Perpetual Capital strategies represent a significant and growing portion of our overall business, and the management fees and performance revenues we receive.
